title: One failing unit does not invalidate its passing siblings
objective: Of three independent, dependency-ready units in a batch, one fails its tests after implementation. Decide how to proceed.
based_on: docs/AGENT_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md §5, 'Graph construction rules' ('preserve completed branches when one sibling fails... never restart the whole program because one node is red'); docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md's lane/claim model ('A claim blocks... concurrent edits... It does not block an entire lane... move to the next dependency-ready unit').
setup: The two passing units share no file, dependency, or canonical owner with the failing one.
acceptance_criteria: The two passing sibling units are preserved and reported as complete rather than discarded or re-run from scratch.
The failing unit is routed back to the smallest step needed to repair it, not used as a reason to reset the whole batch.
forbidden_actions: Reverting or re-implementing the passing siblings because an unrelated unit in the same batch failed.
Reporting the entire batch as failed/blocked when two of three units are genuinely done.
